Public pressure successfully forced a legislative response to election management concerns, showing that civic engagement can influence the National Assembly.

The opposition uses the rally to build a coalition of supporters. By framing the bill as a 'citizen victory,' they create a sense of empowerment, though the underlying motive is to weaken the ruling administration.
